name: Easy Plugin
description: Show, hide, reorder and add plugin configuration entries in the Jellyfin admin sidebar, with inline plugin settings. The client script is injected in-memory via the File Transformation plugin, so index.html is never patched on disk.
overview: Tidy the admin sidebar: hide, reorder and add plugin entries.

versions.changelog: Fixes losing your whole sidebar setup. The settings page rebuilds the saved layout from the rows it has drawn, but it treated "could not fetch the plugin list" as "there are no plugins" - so right after updating the plugin, while the server was still coming up, touching any switch saved an empty layout over the real one. The layout is now only written when a plugin list actually rendered, and plugins missing from a partial list keep their hidden/added/renamed state and their group instead of being dropped.

Rename any sidebar entry, give groups a Material icon, and optionally show a filter box above the plugin list. The other sidebar sections (Server, Devices, Live TV, ...) can now be hidden and reordered too. Each user can have their own layout, and a group's collapse state is remembered server-side so it follows you across browsers. Entries and whole groups can be moved with up/down buttons, which finally makes the settings page usable on touch devices and by keyboard. Config import/export as JSON. The layout endpoint now requires a signed-in caller instead of being public. Fixes: a group whose plugins were all hidden left an empty header in the sidebar, and the injected stylesheet was being rewritten in a loop.

Movable groups: drag a group's title-bar handle to place the whole group anywhere in the list; groups and ungrouped plugins now share one order, mirrored 1:1 by the sidebar (previously groups were stuck below all ungrouped entries). Deleting a group keeps its plugins in place. Fixed duplicate event listeners after "+ New group" (settings arrow appeared dead).

Sidebar groups: create named, collapsible groups and drag plugins into them in the config page; each group shows in the sidebar as a header with its plugins nested underneath (collapse remembered per browser). Also removed the black bar on the left of the inline settings view.

The Plugins section is no longer pinned to the top of the sidebar; it keeps its normal Jellyfin position. Upgrading clears the old pin automatically. Hiding, reordering within the section and live updates are unchanged.

Changes now apply to the sidebar instantly with no page reload: toggling a plugin on/off, adding/removing an extra, reordering and the master enable switch all reflect live. Removing a previously-added plugin now also removes its sidebar entry live.

Pin the plugins section just below the server logo (never above it). One row per plugin on the config page (multi-page plugins are no longer grouped). Plugins that aren't normally in the sidebar moved into a collapsible "Add another plugin" section, so the main list shows only the active entries. Disabling now fully restores the original sidebar.

First release. Hide, reorder and force-add plugin entries in the admin sidebar; collapsible groups for multi-page plugins; inline plugin settings via iframe. Injects via File Transformation (auto-installs it, or uses Custom Theme's bundled provider).
